versions.changelog:
First release of skill-with-prompt-engineering by Gen AI Space.
This skill was built to solve a common problem: most people who try to create prompts or Claude skills on their own end up with results that don't work as intended, because they don't know which prompt engineering technique to apply or how to structure the instructions properly.
This skill fixes that by using Gen AI Space's 16 Prompt Engineering techniques as the foundation for everything it builds.
What this version includes:
Mode 1 helps users create ready-to-use prompts for any task. The skill analyzes the use case, recommends the right technique with a clear reason, asks for missing information before building, and runs a self-review of 2-3 rounds before delivering the final prompt.
Mode 2 helps users build high-quality SKILL.md files for others to use. The skill collects required information, selects the appropriate technique for each section of the SKILL.md, builds a structured draft, and runs the same self-review process before delivering.
Both modes include an optional comparison view showing how the output changed from the first draft to the final version, so users can learn from the process and improve their own prompt engineering skills over time.
If the output doesn't feel right, users can request changes directly in the same chat without editing any files manually.
For more information about the 16 Prompt Engineering techniques used in this skill, visit https://genaispace.net/basic-prompt-advance-prompt/
